verdicts.observation: The 2x shoulder load reads as sticks, but the hair mask also selects several separated wood texels on the left; the white preview whitens the load beyond the two-texel allowance.
The carried sticks are legible, but the mask leaves dark hair patches and includes multiple texels at the right-hand load; the white preview does not isolate whole hair.
The 2x carry pose is clear, but blue coverage reaches the left sticks and several right load texels, producing white marks outside the hair beyond tolerance.
The sticks and south-facing carry pose read clearly. Several brown forehead/fringe hair texels remain inside the white-hair area, and the dark lower facial hair remains uncovered.
The east-facing load is legible, but a multi-texel brown fringe and lower long-hair patch remain outside the mask; the white preview retains substantial brown hair.
The sticks read at 2x, but the white preview retains a broad brown fringe inside the scalp region and the mask extends onto exposed face/arm areas.
The 2x load reads as sticks, but multiple separated left-side stick texels are included in the hair mask and become white in the preview, exceeding the non-hair allowance.
The east-facing carry is recognizable, but the mask covers several left bundle texels, including an isolated outer tip; the white preview whitens wood beyond the allowed two texels.
Rear-view sticks protrude on both sides at 2x. The hair mask also selects multiple left and right bundle/arm texels, producing white non-hair marks beyond tolerance.
Rear-view sticks protrude on both sides at 2x, but the mask includes the left shoulder/load texel and two adjacent right bundle texels, exceeding the two non-hair texel allowance.
The rear carry load is visible on both sides, but one left bundle texel and multiple right bundle texels are recoloured as hair; the white preview exceeds the non-hair tolerance.
The rear bundle reads on both sides, but several separate right stick/hand texels and a left shoulder texel are covered by the mask and turn white.
The crouched pickup reaches a visible stick at 2x, but the white preview leaves the broad dark beard/lower hair region uncovered, exceeding the hair-edge allowance.
The standing south-facing gather frame does not show a clearly identifiable held stick at 2x; the raised dark shape beside the torso reads as an arm/hand mass rather than gathered wood.
The bent east-facing pickup reaches a visible ground stick, but several brown fringe texels remain within the white-hair scalp region; the preview does not recolour the whole hair.
The raised stick is legible, but multiple texels of the stick/hand are selected by the mask and turn white, while brown fringe hair remains uncovered.
